working_definition: Unidentified numbered cluster (class R = photoreceptor) from the Kurmangaliyev 2020 optic lobe atlas. The authors assigned it a cell class but no named cell-type identity.
searches_performed: (placeholder: class-based broad assignment; no literature search performed)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Photoreceptor cell of the compound eye.

justification: No named identity was assigned to cluster R184 by the atlas authors; only its cell class (R) is known. The honest mapping is a broad match to the class-level FBbt term FBbt:00006009 (eye photoreceptor cell). Not a specific cell-type assignment.
recommendation: Class-based broad placeholder (eye photoreceptor cell). Revisit if the cluster's identity is resolved in future work.
